{{Top|leg}}
'''Lightning''' was weather phenomenon that occurred on multiple worlds. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Paigu]] was afflicted by powerful lightning storms that were used by the native [[Paigun]]s to power [[City/Legends|cities]]. Spires on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet were often hit by bolts of multicolored lightning.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] was a remote and inhospitable planet which was covered in [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], and during some parts of the year was covered with heavy electrical storms, where [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] rode on [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwhas]] underwater and resurfaced once they were near their destination.<ref>{{Film|II}}</ref>
